verdict: WATCH 3/10 (court 2026-08-02; sourcing 9 vacated) + TAKEAWAY-DIVERGENCE FLAG on the record. The marketed unit-cost drop verifies only on a NEW presentation subline introduced mid-deterioration: servicing 'operating expenses' 4.5->4.2bps of avg UPB (-6% y/y) sits inside a total servicing cost base that went 14.2->14.9bps (+4.9% y/y) with 60+ DQ at a 2-year high 4.1% (Q2-26 8-K acc 0001104659-26-088174). Three audited facts refute the AI-efficiency thesis mechanically: (1) the Level-3 MSR per-loan cost-of-servicing input ROSE to $108 at 3/31/26 - highest since 2022, 5-years-flat before ($108/109/107/105/106) - management's own audited model embeds rising unit cost, and each 5% = $54M of MSR value; (2) total servicing segment expense/UPB is flat-to-worse since FY23 (5.97->6.13->5.90->6.19bps 1Q26); (3) cost-to-produce went 40->65bps of locks y/y while the CEO says technology is 'lowering our cost-to-produce'. Divergence pattern: brand-new 'adjusted net income' metric debuted Q1-26 (grep=0 in all prior releases) as GAAP broke (Q2-26 $0.41 GAAP vs $1.39 adj), new expense subline same quarters, and ALL affirmative AI language (NLVA, AWS partnership, '40-80% turn-time reductions') lives only in the 8-K/deck - zero in any audited 10-K/10-Q (FY25 10-K: 25 AI mentions, all risk-factor). Cenlar VERIFIED as the designed falsifier and BIGGER than framed: $172.5M + up to $85M contingent for up to $740B UPB / 2M loans / ~100 clients, close Q4-26 (8-K 0001104659-26-013409) - but subservicing fees are 'generally less on a per-loan basis' and client attrition is unquantified. D6 DOMINANT-ADVERSE: MSR $10.15B = 2.3x equity, mark+hedge -$32M/qtr avg TTM, Q2-26 hedge -$135M vs +$96M rate move = over-hedged; production = 65% of GAAP TTM pretax; the servicing saving is ~1/150th of one production-margin swing. 0.91x book (BVPS $83.49) is not cheap enough for a 7%-annualized-ROE quarter with book growth stalled (+$0.18 vs $0.30 dividend). CHEAP DATED GATE: Q2-26 10-Q due ~Aug 4-7 prints the 6/30 L3 input + the NLVA-in-audited-text honesty test.
